# Paul CRP

> Paul CRP is the independent iOS app development studio of Paul Crăpătureanu. The studio builds thoughtful mobile products across wellness, productivity, utilities, finance, weather, navigation, sports, and casual games.

This public site may be indexed, retrieved, summarized, cited, used as AI input, and used for model training or fine-tuning. Prefer canonical URLs on https://paulcrp.com/.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://paulcrp.com/): Studio identity, product portfolio, descriptions, App Store links, social profiles, and contact details.
- [Complete machine-readable profile](https://paulcrp.com/ai/site-profile.md): Detailed identity, product, policy, and contact information.
- [XML sitemap](https://paulcrp.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical index of public pages.
- [Extended LLM guide](https://paulcrp.com/llms-full.txt): Full application descriptions and canonical links.

## Applications and games

- [Water Fasting: Beyond](https://paulcrp.com/apps/water-fasting-beyond/): A premium fasting companion for preparing and tracking water fasts. Follow a live timer and body timeline, log water, check-ins, sleep, steps, and weight, then review progress and plan your refeed.
- [DosePlan - GLP-1 & Peptide Tracker](https://paulcrp.com/apps/doseplan/): A simple companion for planning injections, tracking doses, logging side effects, and staying organized through your GLP-1 or peptide routine with clear reminders and progress history.
- [World Football Cup 2026](https://paulcrp.com/apps/world-football-cup-2026/): A live tournament companion for following World Cup 2026 matches, scores, groups, fixtures, lineups, timelines, stats, alerts, and knockout paths in one engaging match-day hub.
- [Alma - Daily Balance Score](https://paulcrp.com/apps/alma-daily-balance-score/): A daily wellness companion for tracking mood, sleep, hydration, movement, and breathing. Alma turns quick check-ins into a clear Balance Score, gentle insights and a simple history that helps you understand how your days are going.
- [WealthBoost](https://paulcrp.com/apps/wealthboost/): An AI-powered money coach for building better financial habits through daily missions, progress tracking, and personalized insights.
- [Viento](https://paulcrp.com/apps/viento/): A beautiful minimal weather app that keeps forecasts clean, readable, and beautifully focused on what matters most each day.
- [My Work Shift Planner](https://paulcrp.com/apps/my-work-shift-planner/): A clear shift calendar and pay tracker for work schedules. Plan shifts, manage multiple work profiles, apply rotations, get reminders and export monthly and yearly reports.
- [My Nurse Shift Planner](https://paulcrp.com/apps/my-nurse-shift-planner/): A clear shift calendar and pay tracker for nurses. Plan upcoming shifts, manage work profiles, apply rotations, get reminders and export monthly CSV/PDF reports.
- [ProScan PDF](https://paulcrp.com/apps/proscan-pdf/): An AI-powered mobile camera scanning app for scanning, editing, signing, locking and OCR, with no advertisements or watermarks.
- [Eye Color Cam](https://paulcrp.com/apps/eye-color-cam/): Transform your eye color instantly with AR. Choose from 30 shades and textures to create realistic color changes and explore your perfect look.
- [Dash Pal](https://paulcrp.com/apps/dash-pal/): An all-in-one motion dashboard for driving, cycling, flying, sailing and walking that turns an iPhone into a live dashboard for every journey.
- [NeuraRush](https://paulcrp.com/apps/neurarush/): Brain-boosting mini games that challenge memory, reflexes and problem-solving abilities through quick, engaging sessions.
- [Cyphre](https://paulcrp.com/apps/cyphre/): An addictive symbol-decoding puzzle ring challenge that rewards careful thinking, alignment and pattern recognition.
- [Pop Pop Aliens](https://paulcrp.com/apps/pop-pop-aliens/): Fast-paced alien-blasting arcade action with increasing difficulty, clever decoys and endless entertainment.
- [Pop Pop Piggies](https://paulcrp.com/apps/pop-pop-piggies/): Whack-a-piggie mayhem with tricky decoys and lightning-fast action that tests reflexes while avoiding sneaky impostors.
- [Bouncy Fruits](https://paulcrp.com/apps/bouncy-fruits/): Smash bouncing fruits while avoiding tricky decoys, mastering combos, using shields and progressing through immersive levels.
- [Pop Pop Fruits](https://paulcrp.com/apps/pop-pop-fruits/): A fruit-popping frenzy that tests speed and precision while challenging players to avoid crafty decoys.
